name: Urban Ranger
summary: A city hunter who treats streets and settlements as favored ground, finds traps, and disappears into a crowd.

features.name: Favored Community
features.summary: Choose a settlement and gain +2 initiative and bonuses on Knowledge (local), Perception, Stealth, and Survival there.
features.scaling: one additional community at 8th and every 5 levels; increase one bonus by +2 each time

features.name: Trapfinding
features.summary: Add half Ranger level to Perception checks to find traps and Disable Device checks, and disarm magical traps.

features.name: Push Through
features.summary: Ignore difficult terrain and move through harmless citizens in favored communities.

features.name: Blend In
features.summary: Use Stealth in place of Disguise to vanish among citizens of a favored community.

features.name: Invisibility Trick
features.summary: Cast greater invisibility on yourself as a swift action at a caster level equal to Ranger level.
